paper.title: Accurate and Fast Approximate Graph Pattern Mining at Scale

risks: The inspected setup is flagged as requiring a GPU and privileged execution, complicating reproducible sandboxed evaluation and limiting hardware portability.
Although the probe achieved its maximum inspect-only score of 3, no code was executed; compilation, dependency compatibility, and end-to-end benchmark operation remain unverified.
The artifact is hosted at an anonymous archival URL and appears to bundle sizable legacy dependencies, which may make long-term maintenance fragile.
Sampling introduces variance, so scoring needs fixed seeds or repeated trials and explicit statistical tolerances.
Billion-scale workloads may exceed benchmark time and memory budgets; evaluation should use representative bounded subsets and reserve larger cases for a limited final suite.
The paper is from 2025 with no citation or adoption evidence yet, so demonstrated external impact is limited.
